contact.name: Julie Reed
contact.evidence_quote: JULIE REED AIFD, CFD, the owner, director and primary instructor of the Las Vegas School of Floral Design. Purchased the school to assist and improve the quality of the floral industry. Her background stems back over 50 years when she took a one year floral design class in her Native county the UK and working with her parents in a family owned flower shop. Upon arriving in USA she has had the opportunity to create floral design work for many award winning Rose Bowl parade floats, Movie sets, NBC
